Converts a number or a text to a UByte (0 to 255) and stops at 0 and 255 instead of wrapping around. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no integers of other sizes. A whole number outside the range becomes the closest number of the range, and a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) first. A real that is not a number becomes 0. [UByte](UByte) does the same for a real, but wraps whole numbers around.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print SatUByte(100)
Print SatUByte(300)
Print SatUByte(-5)
```

```text
100
255
0
```
@param value  A number or a text with a number in it.
@returns The number, or the closest number of the type if it does not fit.
@gap Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
